config_fields.name: country
config_fields.help: Country code of the price row that update_listing / end_listing change (Seller Center country code of the venture, as used in PUT /v2/product/{productId}/prices/{country}).

adapter.terms: ZALORA Seller Center REST API v2 on the ZALORA GSC instance (sellercenter-api.zalora.com). Country-specific Seller Center instances (zalora.com.my, .sg, .co.id, .com.ph, .com.hk, .com.tw) use their own hosts and token endpoints, which this adapter does not target because the token URL is fixed.

me.note: GET /v2/seller-settings: the authenticated seller's settings, used as the credential check.

update_listing.note: PUT /v2/product/{productId}/prices/{country} {price} merge-patches the LIVE list (regular) price of one variation for the configured country; an existing sale price is kept (salePrice omitted). `listing_id` is the numeric variation productId (GET /v2/product-set/{productSetId}/products). Returns the stored row with status active|inactive and any warnings.

set_inventory.note: PUT /v2/stock/product [{productId, quantity}] synchronously sets the stock of one variation (`listing_id` = numeric productId, required). Products fulfilled by the venture cannot be updated; ignored products are listed in the response.

end_listing.note: PUT /v2/product/{productId}/prices/{country}/status {status: inactive} stops selling the variation in the configured country (reversible with active). Only meaningful for multi-country sellers: single-country (LSC) setups reject inactive with 422.

list_orders.note: GET /v2/orders?limit&offset (both required, sent from limit/page)&section&dateStart, newest first. `status` selects the section filter (status_pending, status_shipped, status_delivered, status_failed, status_canceled, status_pending_all, …); per-item statuses are in raw.statusList / raw.items[].status. raw.number is the customer-facing order number and raw.orderItemIds are needed for status changes.

not_offered.create_listing: POST /v2/product-set needs a category/attribute-set specific payload (brand, attributes, variations with seller SKUs; see /v2/product-sets/sample-payload/{categoryId}); the vocabulary has no category or brand.
not_offered.mark_shipped: POST /v2/orders/statuses/set-to-shipped and /v2/order-item/{orderItemId}/tracking-code act on ORDER ITEM ids (orderItemIds), not on an order id; order item ids are not vocabulary inputs.
